captions.caption: Floodwater rushes through the streets of Theux, Belgium.
Significant flooding affects buildings and streets in Belgium.
A deer swims through deep floodwater in a Belgian street.
The deer navigates the water near submerged parked cars.
The animal struggles to move through the strong current.
Floodwater continues to surge through the urban area.
A river in Belgium overflows, with water rushing under a bridge.
Turbulent brown water flows rapidly beneath a metal bridge structure.
Caution tape is visible on the bridge above the rising river.
The camera pans across the bridge walkway and the rushing water.
Transition to nighttime flooding in Hagen, Germany.
A red truck drives through deep floodwater on a street in Hagen.
Murky water flows quickly through the streets at night.
Intense floodwater surges past streetlights in a residential area.
The entire road is submerged in fast-moving water in Hagen.
Water continues to rush down the street under the night sky.
Floodwater flows past buildings in a heavily affected neighborhood.
The sound of rushing water is prominent as it floods the town.
Dark floodwater covers the ground from building to building.
Large volumes of water move through the street in Germany.
A street corner in Hagen is completely inundated by the flood.
Water surges around street signs and infrastructure at night.
The murky current is very strong in the flooded intersection.
Floodwaters continue to race through the streets of Hagen.
Nighttime view of the powerful and destructive flood in Germany.
Water flows past a pole in the middle of a submerged street.
Transition to scenes of flooding in India.
A car navigates a street deep with floodwater in an Indian city.
View from inside a vehicle driving through the flooded roads.
Homes in rural India are partially submerged in the flood.
Several structures are nearly covered by the rising brown water.
The extent of the flood is visible across a wide landscape.
Roofs of houses are seen poking out from the vast floodwaters.
Trees stand in deep water as the flood persists in India.
Devastated buildings and debris are scattered in the water.
A wide shot shows the massive scale of the flooding in the region.
Muddy water has overtaken the entire village in India.
Submerged roofs indicate the depth of the flood in this area.
The camera pans over the flooded and damaged structures.
Transition to a violent hailstorm in Turin, Italy.
Large hailstones fall rapidly in an Italian parking lot.
Hail bounces off cars and the ground during the storm.
The intensity of the hail creates a white layer on the pavement.
Cars are pelted by heavy hail in a street in Turin.
Visibility is reduced as hail and rain fall together.
A street is covered in white ice from the severe hailstorm.
Hailstones hit a black car parked on a white-covered street.
The hailstones are large and clearly visible as they fall.
A car with its trunk open is seen during the heavy hail.
The storm continues to drop significant amounts of hail.
A green car sits on a street blanketed in hail.
Hail falls in a grassy area with blowing trees.
The ground in a park is turned white by the hailstones.
Heavy precipitation and wind affect the Italian landscape.
Transition to a thunderstorm with a squall in Kazakhstan.
High winds blow debris and rain past a window in Zyryanovsk.
A person captures the violent storm from inside a building.
The squall causes chaotic movement of objects outside.
Intense wind and rain batter the structures in Kazakhstan.
The power of the storm is evident through the window view.
